boundaries.name: keccak_callback
boundaries.obligation: solidity_keccak256 / builder.keccak256 are opaque functions from word lists to Bytes32; no collision resistance and no Rust/Solidity byte-equality is proved.

boundaries.name: channel_action_root_callback
boundaries.obligation: compute_channel_action_root and compute_tx_v2_root are opaque callbacks; nothing about tx-tree binding is proved here.

boundaries.name: native_target_refinement
boundaries.obligation: Target-side definitions are word-level transcriptions of the builder code; plonky2 gate lowering, range checks and witness generation are not modeled.

boundaries.name: word_domain_representation
boundaries.obligation: Nat represents u32/u64/63-bit/field words; range membership is an explicit premise, never an enforced invariant.

boundaries.name: solidity_differential_pins
boundaries.obligation: The pinned Rust/Solidity differential hash constants are not recomputed in Lean; layout equality with the deployed contract remains asserted by those tests only.

boundaries.name: signature_and_membership
boundaries.obligation: Sig-cluster signatures, member-tree inclusion, block-producer authority and on-chain registration authenticity are outside this model.
